input_section_text: Under Australian Privacy Principle 6 (use or disclosure of personal information), under the heading 'Use or disclosure', subclause 6.1 of Schedule 1 of the Privacy Act provides that if an APP entity holds personal information about an individual that was collected for a particular purpose (the primary purpose), the entity must not use or disclose the information for another purpose (the secondary purpose) unless the individual has consented to the use or disclosure of the information; or subclause 6.2 or 6.3 applies in relation to the use or disclosure of the information.

================================================================================
OUTPUT FORMAT
================================================================================
Produce a single valid Gherkin feature file.

Structure:
- Exactly one `Feature:` covering the target section.
- One `Scenario:` for each distinct obligation, prohibition, permission, condition or
  exception in the TARGET SECTION. Do not create scenarios for the supplementary
  context; use that context only to inform wording and to catch related requirements
  that the target section depends on.
- Every `Scenario:` must be preceded by a tag identifying which part of the target
  section it derives from, in the form `@s6-1` plus a short obligation
  slug, for example `@s6-1 @notify-purpose-of-collection`.
- Immediately under each `Scenario:` line, add a comment line beginning `# Derives from:`
  quoting or closely paraphrasing the words of the target section it tests.

Step style:
- `Given` establishes the entity or circumstance the requirement applies to.
- `When` states the handling activity or the individual's request.
- `Then` asserts what the privacy policy must state, disclose or commit to.

Output the Gherkin only. No markdown code fences, no commentary before or after.

llm.text:
Feature: Use or disclosure of personal information

  @s6-1 @prohibit-secondary-use
  Scenario: Prohibition on using or disclosing personal information for a secondary purpose
    # Derives from: "the entity must not use or disclose the information for another purpose (the secondary purpose)"
    Given an APP entity holds personal information about an individual
    When the information was collected for a particular purpose (the primary purpose)
    Then the privacy policy must state that the entity will not use or disclose the information for another purpose unless certain conditions are met

  @s6-1 @require-consent-for-secondary-use
  Scenario: Requirement for individual consent for secondary use or disclosure
    # Derives from: "unless the individual has consented to the use or disclosure of the information"
    Given an APP entity holds personal information about an individual
    When the entity intends to use or disclose the information for a secondary purpose
    Then the privacy policy must disclose that the entity requires the individual's consent for such use or disclosure

  @s6-1 @apply-subclauses-6-2-6-3
  Scenario: Conditions under which secondary use or disclosure is permitted
    # Derives from: "unless subclause 6.2 or 6.3 applies in relation to the use or disclosure of the information"
    Given an APP entity holds personal information about an individual
    When the entity considers using or disclosing the information for a secondary purpose
    Then the privacy policy must explain the conditions under which subclauses 6.2 or 6.3 may apply to permit such use or disclosure
